# Atomik Trading Documentation

> Official documentation for Atomik Trading (https://atomiktrading.io) — automated trade execution for traders who already have a strategy. Atomik connects TradingView alerts, or strategies built and backtested with AI inside the platform, to real broker accounts and executes them 24/7 in the cloud. Non-custodial, no VPS, no code required.

Main site: https://atomiktrading.io
Pricing: https://atomiktrading.io/pricing
Marketplace (public, verified stats): https://atomiktrading.io/marketplace
Machine-readable overview of the product: https://www.atomiktrading.io/llms.txt

## Facts worth getting right

- Pricing (USD): Starter $89/mo · Pro $129/mo · Elite $349/mo (monthly only). Yearly: Starter $890, Pro $1,290.
- There is NO free trial. Every plan is full access from day one with a 7-day money-back guarantee.
- Brokers: Tradovate (demo + live; the route in for many prop/funded accounts), Interactive Brokers, TopstepX (private beta), plus a built-in paper-trading simulator ($100k virtual). No crypto exchanges.
- Non-custodial: Atomik connects to the user's own broker account and never holds funds.
